rules.source: Data Protection Act, 2020 (Jamaica; enacted June/July 2020, Act number cited inconsistently as 7 or 16 of 2020) — https://opm.gov.jm/the-office-of-the-information-commissioner/
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary (pages not fetched): the Office of the Information Commissioner, established December 2021, operates under the Data Protection Act enacted in 2020; the Commissioner monitors compliance, keeps the register of data controllers and investigates complaints; a two-year transition period reportedly ran from 1 December 2021 to 30 November 2023 (dates vary across sources).
